name: Follow Through
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of enduring faithfully to the end, showing that the conclusion of a matter holds greater value than its beginning, especially when accompanied by patience rather than pride, as seen in Ecclesiastes 7:8. The righteous who cry out to the Lord are assured of His deliverance from troubles (Psalms 34:17), and believers are reminded that God will faithfully supply all their needs through Christ Jesus (Philippians 4:19). Ultimately, the promise of Christ’s glorious return (Matthew 25:31) encourages believers to remain steadfast and committed in their walk of faith, exemplifying true follow through.
